results.title: Astronomical Energy Zap with Futuristic Laser Burst
results.author: bassimat
results.description: A sharp, futuristic energy zap with the character of an imaginary astronomical laser discharge. The sound combines a fast electronic attack with a bright spectral burst and a short resonant tail, suggesting a concentrated pulse of energy traveling through space. Suitable for sci-fi environments, spacecraft, imaginary technology, cinematic effects, games, and experimental sound design. Generated by following this amazing guide: https://www.ableton.com/en/blog/zw-buckley-ott/

results.title: Vibrating Jumpscare
results.author: qubodup
results.description: Taking to close a look to the alien egg. That's what its mycelium spores sound like. Created by layering multiple piano notes and drums at the same time in FL Studio and passing the output through Quadrant VST. This was made in a batch of 14, many of which were cleaned up (click removal, fading, levelling, normalization) where necessary in RX and Audacity: Creation Magic Blast Dark Sci-Fi Signal Explosion From Another Dimension Fantasy Implosion Horror Surprise Ion Cannon Jumpscare Magical Mirror Blast Retro Bit Explosion Shockwave Space Explosion Surprise Vibrating Jumpscare ← You Are Here World Ender Explosion

results.title: Horror Pulsating Dissonant Strings
results.author: unfa
results.description: It's the famous horror-movie related music phrase that feels like you're being stabbed in the nerves. Synthesized with ZynAddSubFX, sequenced with LMMS. More info: Notes played: A# and H (called B in US). 8 stabs are played here, forming a gentle crescendo.
